messages:
Sam J.: kickoff: final checklist for EdgeCloud marketplace + SI joint GTM. Need people for: press embargo owner, blog + partner quote, landing hero + screenshots, localized CTAs (EU), staging tenant + demo run. Target publish: Mon Jun 12.

Elena V.: I can take blog + partner quote. ETA draft Fri noon. Need partner legal-approved quote and 2 product bullet points.

Omar R.: landing hero + screenshots here. Prefer short hero: "Redwood & EdgeCloud: fast LLM inference where you run it". Will do 3 screenshots: listing page, latency graph, and demo transcript. Need canonical prompt set.

Tess M.: staging tenant provisioning request in flight. deploy-bot, can you create a tenant with sample data retention 7d and send creds to Omar + Elena?

deploy-bot: Staging tenant created: rwd-edgecloud-mkt-stg-0612. Creds emailed to Omar R., Elena V. Expires in 72 hours.

Omar R.: got creds. Prompt set proposal: short-summary, policy-check, and embedding-search. Will record runs and annotate.

Sam J.: press embargo windows: partner prefers Tue 11:59pm PT. If legal signoff misses Monday noon, fallback = push to Wed. Communicate fallback to comms.

Elena V.: I'll request partner quote by Wed COB. Also drafting two blog angles: 1) technical (latency/cost) 2) business outcome (SIs + customer story). Which should be primary?

Sam J.: primary = technical blog for launch; business follow-up w/ SI case study in week 2.

Tess M.: EU localization: put alternate CTAs: "Try in your region" and "Request EU demo". I can coordinate translations with L10n.

Omar R.: screenshot script (example):

``
# demo run for screenshots
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Draft a 2-sentence product summary for EdgeCloud customers"}'
```

Sam J.: dry run slots: Fri 16:00 PT or Mon 08:00 PT. Recommend Fri for buffer. Who can join?

Elena V.: Fri 16:00 PT works for me. Will bring partner comms and blog outline.

Tess M.: I'll join and validate EU CTAs + staging teardown timing.

Omar R.: will run screenshots + record demo at dry run.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite scheduled: EdgeCloud launch dry run on 2024-06-07T23:00:00Z (Fri 16:00 PT).

Sam J.: owner recap -> Press embargo + fallback: Sam J.; Blog + partner quote: Elena V.; Landing + screenshots: Omar R.; Staging + localization: Tess M.; legal/partner ops: Sam J. Ping here if any blocker.

Elena V.: quick blocker: partner legal wants to review screenshots. I'll loop them into the dry run invite.

Omar R.: noted. will blur any PII in screenshots and keep raw recordings behind S3 ACL.

Sam J.: perf note: ensure listing includes cost per 1k tokens and sample latency numbers. Sales will use that in briefs.

Tess M.: adding perf table to listing draft. will coordinate with infra for exact numbers.

Sam J.: thanks team. I'll publish runbook + final checklist after the dry run. :rocket:
